description: This file contains unit tests for the ContentTypeValidationDirective class, validating content type handling in HTTP requests within the Eclipse Ditto project. It uses JUnit and Akka HTTP testkit to test different scenarios such as valid content types, invalid types, missing charset, non-parsable headers, and case insensitivity of header names.

classes.name: ContentTypeValidationDirectiveTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ContentTypeValidationDirective, testing content type validation logic.

methods.name: testValidContentType
methods.description: Tests that a request with a valid content type passes validation and returns HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: testNonValidContentType
methods.description: Tests that a request with an unsupported content type throws UnsupportedMediaTypeException.

methods.name: testWithContentTypeWithoutCharset
methods.description: Tests handling of a content type without charset, expecting success.

methods.name: testWithoutEntityNoNPEExpected
methods.description: Ensures that requests without an entity do not cause NullPointerExceptions during validation.

methods.name: testExceptionContainsDittoHeaders
methods.description: Verifies that the exception thrown contains the original DittoHeaders.

methods.name: testWithNonParsableContentType
methods.description: Simulates a scenario where Content-Type header cannot be parsed, defaulting to application/octet-stream.

methods.name: testWithUpperCaseContentTypeHeaderName
methods.description: Checks that header name case insensitivity is handled correctly during validation.
